display.purpose: Page headings only — one italic accent word in Rani Rose per heading.

label.purpose: Small uppercase eyebrow text above a page heading, and other uppercase metadata.

nav.purpose: Navigation items and pill/chip labels, desktop and mobile.

body.purpose: Default UI text — antd's base font size for everything else.

shadows.name: sticky-bar
shadows.purpose: Grounds the sticky header/nav bar against scrolled content beneath it.

shadows.name: lifted-card
shadows.purpose: Soft, wide, low-opacity lift on hoverable cards (item cards, the login card).

motion.name: quick-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift — quick and subtle, never dramatic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default primary action button — antd's colorPrimary token.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #A81259; color: #fff; padding: 4px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: Mulish, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C2185B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EAB9CF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip (light surface)
components.description: Category/type filter pill on a white/light background — checkout and gallery filters.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #eed6e0; background: #fff; color: #7a5361; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 22px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip-active { border-color: #A81259; background: #6E0B37; color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A81259; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Nav Pill (dark surface)
components.description: Signature component: the wrapping mobile navigation — every item visible at once on the Wine Maroon header, 44px touch targets, no scroll gesture required.
components.html: <nav class="ds-mobile-nav"><button class="ds-nav-pill ds-nav-pill-active">New Rental</button><button class="ds-nav-pill">Active Rentals</button><button class="ds-nav-pill">Customers</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #6E0B37; } .ds-nav-pill { min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-pill-active { border-color: #EAB9CF; background: #EAB9CF; color: #6E0B37; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EAB9CF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Item Card
components.description: Hoverable inventory/checkout item card — the lifted-card shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #eed6e0; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; padding: 16px; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(110,11,55,0.4); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Mulish, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: #33101F; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: Mulish, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #7a5361; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Page Heading
components.description: The eyebrow + serif-accented heading pattern used at the top of every page.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A81259; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-heading { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.1; color: #33101F; margin: 0; } .ds-heading em { color: #A81259; font-style: italic; }

narrative.overview:
This is an operational tool wearing exactly one ornament: a rich, warm heritage palette (wine maroon, rani rose, petal pink) lifted from the traditional-wear domain it serves, paired with a single serif italic flourish (Cormorant Garamond) on page headings. Everything else in the system is composed and restrained — Mulish for body text, generous whitespace, one accent color used sparingly, fully-rounded tactile controls sized for a shared in-store tablet. The metaphor is a shopkeeper's ledger dressed for a festival: warm and personal at a glance, disciplined and fast the moment you actually use it.

Confirmed mood: warm & festive, composed & restrained, editorial (never corporate-SaaS, never garish or ornamental beyond the one serif accent).
keyCharacteristics: One warm heritage palette, used with restraint — rani rose is the only color that means "active" or "action."
A single serif italic accent word per page heading; everything else is a clean sans.
Fully-rounded, tactile controls (pills, buttons) sized for a tablet, not a mouse.
Shadows are soft, tinted from the maroon hue, and used sparingly — never neutral black.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rani Rose is the only color that means "active" on a light surface. It is not used decoratively — if something is rose, it is either selected, actionable, or the one italic word in a heading.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond appears only in page-heading display type. It never appears in body copy, labels, navigation, or data — the moment it shows up twice on a screen, the flourish stops reading as intentional.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system is tinted from wine maroon (rgba(110,11,55,…)). A neutral black/gray shadow anywhere in this system is a bug, not a style choice.

dos: Do keep Rani Rose as the only "this is active/actionable" signal on light surfaces; introducing a second color for the same meaning dilutes it.
Do tint every shadow from wine maroon (rgba(110,11,55,…)) — never a neutral gray/black shadow.

Do use the dark-surface pill treatment (Petal Pink active, translucent-white inactive, 44px min-height) for anything placed on the Wine Maroon header; the light-surface treatment loses contrast there.
Do keep the serif (Cormorant Garamond) confined to the display heading's single italic accent word — it is a flourish, not a body voice.
donts: Don't add a second accent color for "active" state on light surfaces — Rani Rose already owns that meaning.
Don't use Vivid Magenta (#C2185B) more than once per screen — it exists for rare, singular emphasis, not as a general accent.
Don't give any pill/chip/nav-item a touch target under 44px on the mobile surface — the tablet is tapped constantly and mis-taps between wrapped rows are a real, confirmed failure mode here.
Don't introduce a sharp (0px) or heavily rounded (>14px, short of full pill) corner — the system's entire radius vocabulary is 8 / 14 / full, nothing else.
